title: Enable VPC Flow Logs
scenario: Send ALL VPC traffic to CloudWatch Logs so the security team can investigate anomalies.
constraints: Create a CloudWatch log group and a flow log.

focus.title: Complete the aws_flow_log resource
focus.todo: Add the arguments and nested blocks required for aws_flow_log.

hints.why: A VPC is the network boundary for most AWS resources. CIDR planning, subnets and routing decisions affect everything deployed inside it.
hints.what: Complete the marked region in `main.tf`. The work is inside `resource "aws_flow_log" "this"`. Add the arguments and nested blocks required for aws_flow_log. Use the visible constraints as the checklist for names, values and references before you run the tests.
hints.when: Design a VPC when you need isolated networking, predictable address space or control over public and private traffic.
hints.how: Open `main.tf` and work only inside `resource "aws_flow_log" "this"`. Use this code shape: traffic_type; log_destination; log_destination_type. Use the already-declared references instead of hardcoded values: `aws_cloudwatch_log_group.this.arn`. Keep the block header and braces, indent nested blocks by two spaces, and add one argument or nested block at a time. Run the tests after each small change so the first failure points at the next name to fix.

test_manifest.title: Flow log uses the log group
